GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly then worked up and Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing a half length, held together much same to turn trailing 0.75 Lengths , moved up and took Lead at the 300m, joined at the 175m and raced head'n'head to the post # won in a headbobber
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 3 Lengths turning, Lost Ground in Straight # no excuses
Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths 3 Wide , made no ground to Turn then Held Ground in straight. (Winkers AGAIN) [Stewards: Raced keenly while being restrained early.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly whilst being restrained in the early stages. Raced wide without cover for the majority of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 4 Lengths rail turning, laid out while railing up rounding turn then railed up inside the drifting-out leader, hit Lead 150m, kept going to post. (Cross-over Nose Band OFF FIRST TIME) # on-rail/just lasted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out under pressure round home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Caught 3 Wide No Cover in second half 6 Lengths 800m, hung out badly on turn and proved handful for rider, dropped out from then on, cross over noseband first time, Tongue Tie off first time, winkers off again # hung out/tired
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Raced wide for the majority. Hung out from the 600m until round home turn. Rdr reported gelding may have resented cross-over nose band. Tnr at a loss to explain disappointing performance of gelding, which had trialled well in the lead up to race, adding will remove cross-over nose band before its next race start. Warning for its racing manners. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length then ridden very positivle and Went Forward to Two Wide Lead by half a length, crossed 1050m, Headed 900m then held together much same to turn 2.5 Lengths on fence, Lost Ground in straight. (Winkers AGAIN) # slow/worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Laid in under pressure in the home straight and near the 50m shifted in and bumped hind quarters.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Vetted pre-race. Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (7L from lead). Niggled to stay in touch with bunch at times midrace & chasing Four Wide @ 400m. Chasing Seven Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & ran on OK in last 200m. winkers off first time. # Good for further.
Jumped only fairly then kicked up and Settled Down 1.25 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to trail Two Wide by 0.75 Lengths turning, Lost Ground in Straight # Wide early
Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside Settled Down rear 10 Lengths out 3 Wide with a trail x 700m, clear run home Could Not Get Close At Any Stage - # battled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Over-raced in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well landing on the lead, Settled Down middle of trio behind leading pair 2 Lengths (1000m), 3 Wide 600, Ridden Along 400, cornered taking over & going for home, dashed Clear to the line (Winkers FIRST TIME) # raced clear turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1200m, momentarily eased from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok went Through Inside line of three (1000m), back to a trailing third Soon After , Hard Ridden 500, cornered Under Whip battled away didn't shirk it # sound in going
